root_causes.evidence: Reconciliation session held a ledger write lock (UPDATE accounts batch). Payments logged 'database is locked' errors and the error rate was about 40-64%. After release_lock, write errors dropped to 0 and payments returned to baseline.

An operator changed gateway balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 to 600 s shortly before the incident. That would serve stale balances for 10 minutes. After revert_config to 0.5, the probe shows the app balance matches the ledger.

actions.reason: The reconciliation session holds a ledger write lock and is blocking writes (110 write errors), which explains the payment errors. Release it first; the gateway cache TTL change to 600 s also needs reverting afterwards.
Now revert the gateway balance_cache_ttl_s change from 0.5 to 600 s, which will show stale balances.
actions.detail: gateway balance_cache_ttl_s restored from 600.0 to 0.5 (changed earlier by operator)

sbar.situation: The bank has recovered. All components are at baseline, and the payment probe passed end to end on two clean checks in a row, the last at 43 s.
sbar.background: An operator changed the gateway setting balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 to 600 seconds shortly before the incident. A reconciliation session then held a write lock on the ledger (an UPDATE accounts batch), and payments failed with 'database is locked' errors at about 40-64%.
sbar.assessment: Root causes were the reconciliation lock on the ledger (confidence 0.95) and the gateway cache setting (confidence 0.85), which would serve balances up to 10 minutes stale. The incident commander ended the reconciliation session, and ledger write errors dropped to 0. It then reverted balance_cache_ttl_s to 0.5, and app balances now match the ledger.
sbar.recommendation: The interrupted reconciliation run rolled back, so re-run it off-peak and have operations check for any balance or settlement gaps from the incident window. Confirm with the operator why balance_cache_ttl_s was set to 600 and stop it being reapplied. The screening-standby restarts showed no errors and look benign.
